data.one_liner: A customizable footer widget for Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides FooterView and Footer widgets to create a customizable footer that either stays fixed at the bottom or scrolls when the content overflows. It supports children widgets, background color, padding, alignment, and flex configuration.
use_when: You need a persistent or scrollable footer section at the bottom of a screen.
You want a customizable footer area with custom widgets like copyright text or action buttons.
avoid_when: You require complex persistent navigation bars or standard scaffold bottom navigation bars.
You are not using a scrollable list of widgets inside the page body.
strengths: Easy to integrate with existing Scaffold bodies.
Supports both fixed positioning (when content does not overflow) and scrollable behavior (when content overflows).
Fully customizable footer child widget and styling options (background color, padding, alignment).
weaknesses: Limited feature set beyond basic footer positioning and layout.
Older package with sparse documentation outside basic examples.
